title: Technology Leader - Supply Chain and Manufacturing
jobDescription: ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS. ZS’s Supply Chain & Manufacturing (SCM) Practice helps organizations unlock value across the end-to-end supply chain and manufacturing ecosystem by combining domain knowledge, advanced analytics, AI, and digital innovation. With a team of over 300 experts and practitioners, ZS partners with leading organizations worldwide to drive transformation across planning, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, quality, and operations. The team has successfully delivered more than 100 transformation programs globally across industries including Life Sciences, Consumer Products, Industrials, Automotive, High-Tech, and Energy. As enterprises increasingly embrace AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven decision-making, ZS is helping clients reimagine supply chains and manufacturing organizations as connected, predictive, resilient, and autonomous ecosystems. As a Technology Associate Principal, Supply Chain & Manufacturing , you will lead strategic technology and business transformation initiatives for global clients. You will advise senior executives on supply chain and manufacturing modernization, leveraging AI, Generative AI, advanced analytics, digital platforms, Industry 4.0 technologies, and intelligent automation to drive measurable business outcomes. This is a senior client-facing leadership role responsible for shaping transformation agendas, growing strategic client relationships, building market-leading offerings, and driving business growth for ZS's Supply Chain & Manufacturing Practice. You will collaborate closely with client executives, practice leaders, data scientists, engineers, and consultants to deliver innovative solutions that improve planning effectiveness, operational efficiency, supply chain resilience, manufacturing productivity, and enterprise performance. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders while contributing significantly to practice development, thought leadership, and revenue growth. What you'll do: Develop and execute digital transformation strategies for supply chain and manufacturing clients, from vision to value realization. Lead large-scale supply chain transformation, Industry 4.0/5.0 programs, including Io T, IIo T, cloud, AI/ML, and automation projects across sectors such as Automotive, Life Sciences, Oil & Gas, Agriculture, and Consumer Products. Manage end-to-end project delivery, ensuring on-time, within-budget execution and alignment with client objectives. Develop and manage client relationships on projects. Deeply understand client’s business challenges and provide thought leadership in addressing issues. Identify opportunities and contribute to the selling of additional work to new and existing clients; Active involvement in pre-sales opportunities, building new assets and platforms that will support ZS strategic growth Architect and implement digital solution (e.g., digital twins, predictive analytics, smart sensors, process automation) to optimize manufacturing operations, supply chain, quality and maintenance. Have an eye on Industrial/technology disruptions and develop POVs on how to help clients deal with the same. Drive organizational change management, ensuring adoption of new technologies and digital ways of working. Lead workshops, training, and stakehoder engagement to foster a culture of innovation and data-driven decision making. Serve as a trusted advisor to C-level executives, shaping their digital agendas and guiding strategic investments. Represent ZS at industry forums, publish thought leadership, and contribute to the firm’s digital manufacturing practice growth. What you’ll bring: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field; MBA preferred. 18+ years of professional experience spanning consulting and core industry roles , with a strong blend of strategic advisory, digital transformation leadership, and hands‑on operational exposure in manufacturing environments. Significant tenure in the consulting industry , driving large‑scale transformation programs for global clients, including roadmap definition, operating model design, capability building, and delivery oversight for digital supply chain and manufacturing, IT‑OT integration, control towers, and Industry 4.0/5.0 initiatives. Prior foundational experience in the core manufacturing industry , providing deep understanding of real‑world plant operations, production processes, supply chain dynamics, and technology adoption challenges within complex industrial setups. Deep expertise in Digital Supply Chain , Industry 4.0/5.0, Io T/IIo T, cloud platforms, Supply Chain Control Towers, AI/ML, automation , and IT‑OT integration , along with hands‑on experience implementing digital manufacturing solutions (MES, QMS, LIMS, PIMS, SCADA, historians, edge computing, etc.). Strong knowledge of supply chain and manufacturing processes across multiple sectors (e.g., Automotive, Life Sciences, Oil & Gas, FMCG), combining core industry exposure with consulting‑led transformation experience. Proven ability to lead cross‑functional and multi‑geography teams, manage P&L or portfolio-level financials, and deliver complex, multi‑tower digital programs in advisory and delivery roles. Certifications such as PMP, Scrum Master, SIRI Assessor, or equivalent are a plus. How you’ll grow: Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions Hybrid working model: ZS is committed to a Flexible and Connected way of working. ZSers are onsite at clients or ZS offices three days a week. Combined flexibility to work remotely two days a week is also available. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections. How you’ll grow: Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions Perks & Benefits: At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. title: Business Technology Solutions Associate (CMC)
jobDescription: ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS. ZS’s Technology group focuses on scalable strategies, assets and accelerators that deliver to our clients enterprise-wide transformation via cutting-edge technology. We leverage digital and technology solutions to optimize business processes, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation. ZS is looking to hire a Business Technology Solutions Associate in ZS' Supply Chain and Manufacturing practice with experience in pharmaceutical drug development and tech transfer. The primary responsibility of this role is to deliver projects in the pharmaceutical CMC development area for ZS clients. The successful candidate will leverage their expertise in using and implementing digital laboratory systems such as Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), Electronic Lab Notebooks (ELN), and ensuring GLP-compliant solutions to support CMC workflows; along with supporting Digital and Technology advisory, Product and Platform development and Data, Analytics and AI implementation. What you’ll do : Support clients in adopting and optimizing digital laboratory solutions (e.g., LIMS, ELN) and embedding GLP-aligned data management practices within CMC development workflows Configure, customize, and deploy LIMS platforms to support sample tracking, workflow automation, and regulatory reporting Implement and integrate ELN solutions for experiment documentation, protocol standardization, and collaboration across research and quality teams Ensure systems and processes comply with GLP standards, including audit readiness, data integrity, and alignment with regulatory requirements Partner with scientists, quality, and IT teams to digitize and scale laboratory workflows Undertake complete ownership in accomplishing activities and assigned responsibilities across all phases of project lifecycle to solve business problems across one or more client engagements. Apply appropriate development methodologies (e.g.: agile, waterfall) and best practices (e.g.: mid-development client reviews, embedded QA procedures, unit testing) to ensure successful and timely completion of assignments. Collaborate with other team members to leverage expertise and ensure seamless transitions; Exhibit flexibility in undertaking new and challenging problems and demonstrate excellent task management. Assist in creating project outputs such as business case development, solution vision and design, user requirements, prototypes, and technical architecture (if needed), test cases, and operations management. Bring transparency in driving assigned tasks to completion and report accurate status. Bring Consulting mindset in problem solving, innovation by leveraging technical and business knowledge/ expertise and collaborate across other teams. Assist senior team members, delivery leads in project management responsibilities. Build complex solutions using Programing languages, ETL service platform, etc. What you’ll bring: Bachelor's or master's degree required in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Material Engineering, Computer Science, Chemistry, Biotechnology or similar degree 1+ years of relevant post-collegiate job experience. A Ph D may substitute in lieu of work experience. Hands-on experience with at least one of the functions in CMC development such as Process Chemistry, Process Engineering, Formulation, and Analytical Chemistry Understanding of the different data and information systems such as ELN, LIMS, ERP systems, and LCM or PLM systems Experience contributing to the implementation of LIMS, ELN, or GLP-compliant digital systems, with focus on improving CMC data integrity, regulatory readiness, and lab-to-business process alignment Willingness to develop expertise in system configuration, validation, and compliance aspects of pharmaceutical digital lab solutions. Knowledge of key concepts including unit operations, processes, quality by design (Qb D), tech transfer, process validation, quality attributes, and regulatory milestones across pharma development Understanding of the CMC related regulatory submission requirements Experience with at least one tech transfer, explore to analytics, AI and/or technology implementation in CMC preferred Strong ability to identify data anomalies, design data validation rules, and perform data cleanup to ensure high-quality data. Project management and task planning experience, ensuring smooth execution of deliverables and timelines. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with both technical and non-technical teams. Experience with automation testing High motivation, good work ethic, maturity and personal initiative. Self-discipline for planning and organizing tasks Aptitude for, and enjoyment of, working in teams Fluency in English Client-first mentality Intense work ethic Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to structure thoughts logically during discussions and presentations Capability to simplify complex concepts into easily understandable frameworks and presentations Proficiency in working within a virtual global team environment, contributing to the timely delivery of multiple projects Travel to other offices as required to collaborate with clients and internal project teams How you’ll grow: Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions Perks & Benefits: At ZS, your growth matters. jobDescription:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Senior Cloud Administrator We seek an experienced, professional Sr. Cloud Administrator to join our Pune, India office. This role is responsible for deploying and administering a cloud-based computing platform within ZS. What You’ll Do: As an Sr. Cloud Administrator in the Enterprise you will
- Manage end-to-end Salesforce deployments across Dev, QA, UAT, Pre-Prod, and Production environments. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines using SFDX CLI with Jenkins, Azure Dev Ops, and Git Hub Actions. Work with Salesforce deployment tools such as Copado and Gearset. Manage release planning, deployment execution, release notes, approvals, and post-release validation. Define and support branching strategies including feature, release, hotfix, and main branches. Implement quality gates such as validation deployments, Apex test execution, code coverage checks, and static code analysis. Support rollback planning, deployment recovery, and production issue resolution. Manage back sync activities to ensure production changes are aligned with lower environments and source branches. Support Salesforce backup and recovery processes before major releases. Plan and execute sandbox refreshes and post-refresh activities. Support sandbox seeding and test data preparation for QA and UAT. Ensure data masking and data privacy controls are applied in lower environments. Maintain metadata consistency across Salesforce environments. Support multi-country Salesforce implementations with country-specific configurations and release dependencies. Ensure security and compliance considerations are followed during deployments. Maintain Dev Ops documentation, release checklists, rollback plans, and environment governance standards. Required Skills 3–6 years of Salesforce experience with strong focus on Dev Ops and Release Management. Hands-on experience with SFDX CLI and Metadata-based Salesforce deployments. Experience with Jenkins, Azure Dev Ops, and Git Hub Actions. Experience with Copado and/or Gearset. Strong understanding of Git version control and branching strategy. Good knowledge of Salesforce Admin concepts including profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, objects, fields, flows, and validation rules. Experience managing Salesforce releases across multiple environments. Experience with rollback, back sync, backup, sandbox refresh, sandbox seeding, and data masking. Understanding of Salesforce security model and deployment governance. Experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud. Experience working on multi-country Salesforce implementations. title: Senior Cloud Monitoring Administrator
jobDescription: ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS. What you'll do: Senior Cloud Monitoring Administrator in the Enterprise will be monitoring and managing IT systems across Windows, Linux, VMware , and Cloud environments. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of ITIL processes , strong technical expertise in Solar Winds for infrastructure monitoring, and hand-on with Splunk for log analysis and event correlation. This is a 24x7 support role requiring proactive system monitoring, incident response, and adherence to ITIL-based Incident , Problem , and Change Management processes. Exposure to AWS , Team City , and network fundamentals will be considered an added advantage. Monitoring & Incident Management: Act as a Solar Winds Administrator responsible for platform operations , configuration, and monitoring using NPM, SAM, NCM, UNDP, IPAM, and other modules. Manage Solarwinds Application patching . Design, tune, and manage Solar Winds alerts/Reports, thresholds, and notification policies. Monitor end-to-end infrastructure health via Solar Winds dashboards, reports, and real-time views. Perform first-line triage on Solar Winds alerts and take corrective actions to restore services. Manage incident lifecycle following ITIL Incident Management practices. Use Splunk for log analysis, event correlation, and troubleshooting. Identify recurring issues and support Problem Management investigations. Server & OS Administration: Monitor Windows and Linux server health using Solar Winds SAM templates and custom monitors. Perform first-level troubleshooting, including service restarts, log review, and system health checks. Use i DRAC (or equivalent remote access tools) for hardware diagnostics and remote reboot operations. Support scheduled patching and maintenance activities in accordance with Change Management practices. Virtualization & Cloud Support: Monitor VMware ESXi hosts and VMs using Solar Winds Virtualization Manager (VMAN). Perform initial troubleshooting for host connectivity, datastore usage, and VM availability issues. Support AWS Cloud monitoring, performance reviews, and cost analysis as part of hybrid infrastructure operations. Network & Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor network performance, device availability, and link utilization using Solar Winds Network Performance Monitor (NPM) . Understand basic networking concepts such as IP addressing, routing, switching, DNS, and connectivity troubleshooting. Coordinate with network and infrastructure teams for escalations and root cause investigations. What you’ll bring: Comprehensive understanding of the ITIL framework , with hands-on application of Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes. Strong experience with Solar Winds , including infrastructure and network monitoring, alert configuration, and performance optimization. Hands-on with Splunk (SIEM) for advanced log analysis, alert correlation, and event investigation. Solid grasp of network fundamentals , including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, and connectivity troubleshooting. Practical experience in Windows Server and Linux administration , including system monitoring and troubleshooting. Working knowledge of VMware ESXi and v Center , with the ability to monitor and maintain virtualized environments. Familiarity with remote server management tools such as i DRAC for hardware diagnostics. Strong documentation and communication skills , with experience using ticketing and ITSM tools like Service Now or Jira . Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 support and shift-based operational environment. AWS Cloud monitoring and troubleshooting experience, preferred Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Team City for automation and reporting, preferred ITIL Foundation Certification, preferred Basic scripting knowledge (e.g., Power CLI , Power Shell , or Python ) for reporting and automation , preferred Fluency in English Client-first mentality Intense work ethic Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach How you’ll grow: Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions Perks & Benefits: At ZS, your growth matters. jobDescription:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. - Client Accounting (Sales Operations) We seek a financial professional for a Finance Associate
- Client Accounting role in our Pune, India office. As an Associate in Sales Operations / Order Management, within Client Accounting, you will support the contract-to-project setup process for professional services engagements helping ensure signed client documents (e.g., MSA/SOW/PO) are translated into accurate SAP customer project/WBS and billing setup so delivery teams can execute and Finance can invoice and apply revenue policies. Your work is execution-focused and completed within defined SOPs, templates, and checklists, with routine review by senior team members and clear escalation paths for exceptions. What y ou’ll d o: Contract intake, completeness checks, and operational validation (under supervision) Perform initial review for completeness and readiness of incoming client documents (e.g., fully executed agreement, required fields/data present), and organize the contract record so it is accessible to internal stakeholders. Validate that key operational terms are clear enough to enable project setup and billing setup, and flag gaps/ambiguities for senior/Finance/Legal review rather than interpreting them independently. SAP services project setup support (functional end-user scope) You will support foundational setup activities that enable billing, using guided processes rather than configuration work. Support creation/maintenance of billing items for customer projects, in collaboration or overlap with billing team (including selecting contract type such as Fixed Price or Time & Expenses; assigning work packages; entering amounts/caps; maintaining billing due dates/billing plan items; and capturing customer references such as PO) Cross-functional coordination (primarily internal-facing) Coordinate with Sales, Delivery/Project teams, and finance to collect missing inputs, clarify basic items (e.g., dates, PO references, billing schedule), and keep the setup moving through the standard workflow. Provide routine status updates and document actions/decisions taken, maintaining an audit-ready trail of changes and approvals as required by the workflow. Documentation hygiene and operational reporting support Maintain organized records and trackers (e.g., contract intake status, setup progress, exception logs) to support day-to-day visibility and handoffs. Support basic operational reporting aligned to the process (e.g., volumes processed, cycle time, rework themes) as defined by the team’s governance model. Contract elements you will typically review and validate within Associate scope of experience & expertise You will focus on operationally actionable contract elements that drive project setup and billing structure—not legal interpretation. Common validation checklist items include: Scope/deliverables and timelines: ensuring deliverables, milestones, and timelines are stated clearly enough to align to project structure and billing phases. Payment structure and triggers: confirming whether billing is milestone-based, periodic, or time & expenses—and ensuring the setup can reflect those triggers. Basic contract data required for setup: parties/contact information, effective/expiration dates, and required customer references (e.g., PO) for linkage to sales/billing documents. Billing plan and method alignment: verifying that the invoice method and revenue method classification selected/entered aligns to the contracted payment structure (and escalating mismatches). Revenue recognition awareness (coordination-only; no accounting ownership) You are expected to have awareness of ASC 606/IFRS 15 concepts and recognize when contract terms may impact Finance’s revenue decisions; however, you do not determine accounting treatment, standalone selling price allocation, or final revenue recognition conclusions. Practical awareness expected: Familiarity with the five-step model structure (identify contract; identify performance obligations; determine transaction price; allocate price; recognize revenue) at a high level, so you can spot terms that could affect setup and downstream treatment. Accuracy and attention to detail: when translating contract terms into SAP billing/project setup fields. Process discipline: ability to follow SOPs, maintain documentation, and preserve required audit trails. Clear written communication: for internal coordination and structured escalation. Comfort working with global stakeholders: through defined handoffs, including support for contracts across regions via documented workflows. What you’ll bring: Master’s degree in finance, economics, or business required, with a strong record of academic achievement. 0-3 years of Sales and Order Management experience. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PPT, Outlook), SAP experience desirable; Strong analytic and critical thinking abilities. Effective oral and written communication skills that enable strong relationship-building and stakeholder management. Strong attention to detail. Motivated and proactive. Professional objectivity and judgment to know when to challenge activities. Ability to multi-task in a fast paced, rapidly-changing environment. title: Finance Associate - Client Accounting
jobDescription:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS. Finance Associate
- Client Accounting (Sales Operations) We seek a financial professional for a Finance Associate
- Client Accounting role in our Pune, India office. As an Associate in Sales Operations / Order Management, within Client Accounting, you will support the contract-to-project setup process for professional services engagements helping ensure signed client documents (e.g., MSA/SOW/PO) are translated into accurate SAP customer project/WBS and billing setup so delivery teams can execute and Finance can invoice and apply revenue policies. Your work is execution-focused and completed within defined SOPs, templates, and checklists, with routine review by senior team members and clear escalation paths for exceptions. What y ou’ll d o: Contract intake, completeness checks, and operational validation (under supervision) Perform initial review for completeness and readiness of incoming client documents (e.g., fully executed agreement, required fields/data present), and organize the contract record so it is accessible to internal stakeholders. Validate that key operational terms are clear enough to enable project setup and billing setup, and flag gaps/ambiguities for senior/Finance/Legal review rather than interpreting them independently. SAP services project setup support (functional end-user scope) You will support foundational setup activities that enable billing, using guided processes rather than configuration work. Support creation/maintenance of billing items for customer projects, in collaboration or overlap with billing team (including selecting contract type such as Fixed Price or Time & Expenses; assigning work packages; entering amounts/caps; maintaining billing due dates/billing plan items; and capturing customer references such as PO) Cross-functional coordination (primarily internal-facing) Coordinate with Sales, Delivery/Project teams, and finance to collect missing inputs, clarify basic items (e.g., dates, PO references, billing schedule), and keep the setup moving through the standard workflow. Provide routine status updates and document actions/decisions taken, maintaining an audit-ready trail of changes and approvals as required by the workflow. Documentation hygiene and operational reporting support Maintain organized records and trackers (e.g., contract intake status, setup progress, exception logs) to support day-to-day visibility and handoffs. Support basic operational reporting aligned to the process (e.g., volumes processed, cycle time, rework themes) as defined by the team’s governance model. Contract elements you will typically review and validate within Associate scope of experience & expertise You will focus on operationally actionable contract elements that drive project setup and billing structure—not legal interpretation. Common validation checklist items include: Scope/deliverables and timelines: ensuring deliverables, milestones, and timelines are stated clearly enough to align to project structure and billing phases. Payment structure and triggers: confirming whether billing is milestone-based, periodic, or time & expenses—and ensuring the setup can reflect those triggers. Basic contract data required for setup: parties/contact information, effective/expiration dates, and required customer references (e.g., PO) for linkage to sales/billing documents. Billing plan and method alignment: verifying that the invoice method and revenue method classification selected/entered aligns to the contracted payment structure (and escalating mismatches). Revenue recognition awareness (coordination-only; no accounting ownership) You are expected to have awareness of ASC 606/IFRS 15 concepts and recognize when contract terms may impact Finance’s revenue decisions; however, you do not determine accounting treatment, standalone selling price allocation, or final revenue recognition conclusions. Practical awareness expected: Familiarity with the five-step model structure (identify contract; identify performance obligations; determine transaction price; allocate price; recognize revenue) at a high level, so you can spot terms that could affect setup and downstream treatment. Accuracy and attention to detail: when translating contract terms into SAP billing/project setup fields. Process discipline: ability to follow SOPs, maintain documentation, and preserve required audit trails. Clear written communication: for internal coordination and structured escalation. Comfort working with global stakeholders: through defined handoffs, including support for contracts across regions via documented workflows. What you’ll bring: Master’s degree in finance, economics, or business required, with a strong record of academic achievement. 0-3 years of Sales and Order Management experience. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PPT, Outlook), SAP experience desirable; Strong analytic and critical thinking abilities. Effective oral and written communication skills that enable strong relationship-building and stakeholder management. Strong attention to detail. Motivated and proactive. Professional objectivity and judgment to know when to challenge activities. Ability to multi-task in a fast paced, rapidly-changing environment. title: Senior User Interface Designer
jobDescription: ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS. As a Senior UX/UI Designer at ZS Associates, you will help lead the design of AI-powered digital products, predictive analytics interfaces, and enterprise-scale healthcare solutions. You’ll guide experience strategy, translate research insights into scalable design patterns, and collaborate closely with UX designers, researchers, and developers to bring intuitive, high-quality interfaces to life across web and mobile platforms. Your work will include creating wireframes, high-fidelity mock-ups, interactive prototypes, and polished design assets, as well as contributing to design systems that ensure consistency across products. You will also leverage Gen AI design tools to accelerate key workflows from research synthesis to ideation and prototyping—while conducting UI audits to enhance usability, accessibility, and visual coherence. The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with a deep understanding of usability principles, accessibility best practices, and modern design heuristics. Familiarity with Gen AI design accelerators and the ability to communicate design rationale clearly will be essential as you help shape conversations with clients and internal teams. Apply structured problem-solving and systems thinking to break down ambiguous problem spaces. Ability to map complex business rules, multi-role workflows, and process dependencies into intuitive user journeys. What you’ll do : UX/UI Design: Strong visual design skills with the ability to create modern, intuitive interfaces for complex web and mobile applications. Experience producing wireframes, mockups, prototypes, style guides, icons, and other core UI assets. Ability to collaborate with UX leads, developers, and cross-functional teams throughout the user-centered design process. Understanding of usability, accessibility, design heuristics, and platform-specific technical limitations. Proficiency with design and prototyping tools (Figma, Axure, HTML prototypes, etc.). Ability to design AI-driven workflows, predictive dashboards, conversational UI, and Gen AI-enabled experiences. Skill in translating business and analytics requirements into scalable interaction patterns and high-fidelity designs. Familiarity with using generative AI tools to accelerate research synthesis, ideation, and design variations. Experience contributing to or evolving design systems, including components for AI-powered products. Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate with clients and guide junior designers. Ability to support or conduct UX research and synthesize insights into actionable design direction. Experience facilitating workshops, design reviews, and design sprints for concept validation. Strong experience designing multi-level analytics dashboards. Ability to translate analytical metrics into clear, intuitive, decision-support UI components. What you’ll bring: Qualifications ZS welcomes candidates who hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a visual design field, including graphic design, interaction design, illustration, or a comparable design discipline. We are looking for individuals with 5–7 years of experience in UX/UI Design, with a strong focus on designing and delivering complex, high-volume, high-profile business or enterprise applications such as portals, business applications, mobile apps, interactive dashboards, data visualizations, and information-rich systems. Candidates should have experience designing analytics-driven and AI-enabled workflows, including conversational interfaces, recommendation systems, decision-support tools, and agentic task flows. Proficiency with Gen AI design tools, the ability to structure ambiguous problem spaces, and the capability to develop scalable interaction patterns are highly valued. Strong communication skills, client collaboration experience, and the ability to explain and defend design decisions are essential. The role requires strong teamwork and leadership capabilities. Experience mentoring junior designers, contributing to design systems, and applying core consulting skills such as managing tasks, synthesizing feedback, and articulating design choices is important. Familiarity with regulated industries such as healthcare or pharma is a plus. Your skills will help us deliver UX design services to clients, stakeholders, and internal teams as you participate in a user-centered, collaborative design process. How you’ll grow: Ability to proactively identify and address issues independently, and display ownership of and responsibility for work. A functional understanding of enterprise software is preferred, as well as being adept at collaborating with other members of the UX team and technical teams to reach feasible design solutions for portals, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, content management systems, collaboration technologies, and Business Intelligence (BI) systems. Previous experience working in pharmaceutical industry and knowledge of healthcare is a plus UXUI Experience: A strong portfolio featuring design work for enterprise, that showcases visual design for mobile or desktop applications, infographics, iconography, logos or other design work, and how it leads to positive business outcomes. Strong hands-on experience with modern design tools such as Figma, Figma Make, AI-powered design tools, and the Adobe Creative Suite (especially Adobe Illustrator). Demonstrated ability to translate a client’s brand into modern-looking user interfaces and other digital multimedia, following visual design best practices for mobile and desktop applications. Demonstrated ability to create and follow a style guide or other visual design documentation and leverage it to execute mock-ups for clients and stakeholders. Proficiency designing for Gen AI and AI-powered experiences , including chat UX, agentic task flows, AI copilots, explainable AI (XAI) elements, recommendation UX, and multi-step AI-driven workflows. Ability to structure AI-assisted decision journeys with rationales, confidence indicators, next actions, and safety boundaries. Experience collaborating with and/or supporting user experience research and/or design teams is a plus. An understanding of modern BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) and low code applications (e.g. Power Apps, SFDC), as well as UI Frameworks is highly desirable. Experience working with cross-functional teams, including UX, business (e.g. Marketing, Sales), product management and/or technology/IT/engineering) is a plus. Client Management and Communication: Strong oral and written communication skills, especially the ability to clearly articulate and document design decisions with stakeholders and development teams and keep UX and Project Team leads up to date. Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to contribute to design discussions that help to obtain consensus and move projects forward. Ability to participate in a team environment where individuals can communicate and contribute freely. Listens carefully to client and team requests, asks questions that help to drive discussions forward. Ability to communicate complex information in a meaningful way that is easy to understand. Candidates should have the ability to travel to client locations (25%) to work with teams and provide in-person expertise. Candidates must possess permanent work authorization for their intended country of employment. Hands-on experience with Ia C (Terraform/ARM/Bicep), automation (Power Shell/CLI), container security (AKS). Strong foundation in security design patterns, Zero-Trust principles, IAM, network segmentation, encryption. Experience across multicloud (Azure + AWS and/or GCP) security architectures. Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer / Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Security Specialty, AI/Data security related certification advantage Practical experience applying AI/ML for security (anomaly detection, SIEM/SOAR automation, AI-assisted threat intelligence). title: Technology Leader - Life Sciences R&D
jobDescription:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS. You will be part of ZS R&D space with focus on Integrated Evidence team. The team combines deep domain knowledge in evidence generation with advanced analytics, technology solutions, and strategic consulting to help organizations navigate the complex landscape of regulatory approval, market access, and value demonstration. Through decades of experience working with global life sciences companies, ZS has developed comprehensive capabilities that span from early-stage evidence planning through post-market evidence generation, positioning the organization as a trusted partner for companies seeking to optimize their evidence strategies and accelerate commercial success. Role &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
This role will have responsibility to take ownership of one or more client engagements at a cross office level encompassing the areas of business intelligence, analytics, Cloud Data management, reporting and mobility; provide thought leadership in developing the firm’s services and offerings in the Business Technology space and add leverage to the overall leadership span for the aforementioned group in India. The person in this role will be responsible for growing the capabilities in the Business Technology group by developing and managing the existing client relationships and also aid in generating new business engagements. This person will need to fully understand the company and its service lines and actively assess/present ways to serve clients by developing solutions and offerings relevant to that client base. The successful candidate will work closely with ZS leadership; grow the practice by expanding client and customer relationships and building trusted advisory relationships with executives at the company’s various accounts.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead large scale client business development and delivery engagements in the Life Sciences Industry
- Pharmaceutical and/or Medical Devices sector; Consistently deliver quality client services and drive high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget; Monitor progress, manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes; Stay abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the pharma Clinical & Integrated evidence planning; Effectively lead and motivate teams with diverse skills and backgrounds; Provide constructive on-the-job feedback/coaching to team members; Foster an innovative and inclusive team-oriented work environment; Play an active role in counseling and mentoring junior consultants within the organization; Demonstrate deep life sciences industry sector knowledge with a functional expertise across operations; Demonstrate ability to quickly assimilate new knowledge; Possess in depth business acumen; Remain current on new developments in advisory services capabilities and industry knowledge.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's degree with an emphasis in Business or Life Sciences; MBA or Advanced Degree is highly desirable; 12+ years’ experience in life science industry management consulting; 5+ years’ experience in a leadership role within a professional services firm; Demonstrated experience with driving revenue within existing clients and in developing new prospects at the "C" level of Pharmaceutical and Medical Device companies; Prior experience in Analytics, Big Data, Cloud, Digital Asset Management, Master Data Management and Data Warehousing as it related to patient data or clinical or Real world evidence ; Strong credentials and demonstrated success in IT strategy and Enterprise Architecture; Deep knowledge and understanding of BI/DW technologies and solutions; Characteristics of a forward thinker and self-starter that thrives on new challenges and adapts quickly to learning new knowledge; Ability to lead a virtual team of consulting professionals across multiple projects; A high level of motivation and self-starting attitude; Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; Excellent oral and written communication skills; A strong work ethic; A willingness to travel to meet client needs; Executive-level presence and communication. ZS is a global consulting firm; fluency in English is required, additional fluency in at least one European or Asian language is desirable. title: Enterprise Architect - Life Sciences R&D
jobDescription: ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS. ZS’s Architecture & Engineering Expertise Center hosts passionate tech professionals with focus on deep technology skills, incubation of new technologies, build and manage assets, cater to architecture skills needed for client projects. This track is about bringing and nurturing deep technical talent within ZS to engage with technical IT clients and de-risk large scale technology programs that are increasingly under scrutiny for technical, and architectural best practices. In this role, you will be aligned to Life Sciences R&D team of ZS working across multiple clients in designing and developing cutting edge R&D solutions which will help clients to discover and develop innovative medicines that improve patient’s lives. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in architecting solutions for study design, feasibility, custom clinical data repositories (CDRs), statistical computing environments (SCEs), and advanced clinical analytics platforms such as RBQM and Control Towers. Experience with systems integration (SI), cloud architecture (AWS/Azure), and a solid understanding of the clinical/R&D domain is essential. ENTERPRISE ARCHITECT – R&D What You’ll Do: Lead the end-to-end architecture and technical design of clinical and R&D IT solutions, including study design, feasibility tools, SCEs, and custom CDRs. Drive the architecture of advanced analytics platforms like Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM), clinical control towers, and real-time data insights systems. Collaborate cross-functionally with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, and external vendors to align technology solutions with business goals. Design robust and scalable solutions consistent with ZS and industry practices; take advantage of the existing assets and maintain a balance between architecture requirements and specific client needs. Define and maintain enterprise and solution architecture standards, ensuring alignment with security, scalability, and compliance requirements. Develop AI based agentic architectures for supporting solution need e.g. AI Agent based content authoring Oversee systems integration between EDC, CTMS, e TMF, CDR, and downstream analytics platforms. Serve as the architectural lead on custom-built applications and digital initiatives in the clinical data management and analytics space. Ensure architectural compliance with regulatory frameworks (e.g., Gx P, 21 CFR Part 11). Create architecture artifacts: solution blueprints, reference architectures, integration diagrams, and technical roadmaps. Collaborate with security and infrastructure teams on cloud-native deployments (AWS or Azure) and Dev Sec Ops strategies. Mentor technical teams and support architectural governance across project delivery. What You’ll Bring: Bachelor's degree with specialization in Computer Science, IT or other computer related disciplines; 12+ years of relevant experience in designing & developing technology solutions on an enterprise-scale for Life Science R&D space; Strong knowledge of clinical systems landscape (e.g., EDC, CTMS, e TMF, e COA, CDMS, SDTM, ADa M, SAS). Expertise in cloud architecture using AWS and/or Azure including serverless, containers, API management, and security best practices. Deep understanding of integration patterns, data pipelines, and real-time analytics architecture. Experience with data governance, metadata management, and compliance standards in life sciences. Specializes in architecting modern data ecosystems leveraging technologies such as Azure, AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, and Hadoop Demonstrated expertise in building scalable data pipelines, real-time streaming architectures, and enterprise-grade data lakes and warehouses. Known for cross-functional leadership in aligning business needs with technical roadmaps, enabling analytics, AI/ML, and decision intelligence. Skilled in Agile delivery models, stakeholder management, and building Centres of Excellence (Co Es) to drive innovation in data engineering practices. Additional Skills Thought leadership in the form of articles, blogs, forums, papers etc. on data engineering will be preferred. Experience in key components like data governance & curation, data quality and master data management, data integration, data virtualization, self-service interaction for data preparation and testing is a plus. title: Decision Analytics Associate Consultant - RWD
jobDescription: ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS. Insights & Analytics ZS's Insights & Analytics group partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership. What You’ll Do Develop and apply advanced statistical models that help clients understand dynamic business issues. Leverage analytic techniques to use data to guide client and ZS team decision-making. Design custom analyses in R, Tableau, SAS, Visual Basic and Excel to investigate and inform client needs. Synthesize and communicate results to clients and ZS teams through oral and written presentations. Develop client relationships and serve as key point of contact on aspects of projects. Provide client and ZS teams project status updates. Create project deliverables and implement solutions. Advance problem-solving skills and improve ZS’s capabilities; Guide and mentor Associates on teams. What You’ll Bring Experience in working with the Pharma Industry. Experience in working with real world data sources such as patient claims data, EMR, consumer data etc Experience in analysis of large data sets; SQL-R, programming skills Experience in the statistical design and analysis of prospective or retrospective observational studies and familiar with working with large epidemiological datasets focusing on anonymized data 3 – 6 years’ work experience with domain knowledge/expertise in Healthcare/Life Sciences/Med Tech is preferred MBA with bachelor's (and often graduate) degrees in engineering, business, psychology or physical/life sciences with a strong academic record of analytic and quantitative work Agile project planning and project management skills Excellent communication skills How you’ll grow: Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions Perks & Benefits: At ZS, your growth matters.
